solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: In favour of inscribing thin copy

indicators.note: to inscribe is to write within, so the word for thin holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: to thin something is to reduce it
pro means in favour of

explanation.surface: Someone backs a thin, perhaps faint, copy of a document being written out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thin' looks like an adjective describing the copy, but it is a verb, to make less.
explanation.definitionFit: To reproduce something is to make a copy of it; both are verbs here.

clue.text: Set river excavation up below island

indicators.note: in a down clue below puts the dig after the island
up in a down clue means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: a dig is an archaeological excavation

explanation.surface: An excavation by a river is set up below an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Set in the sense of firm or fixed, as jelly sets, means rigid.

clue.text: Blend drink harbour team takes with whiskey over by road

indicators.note: by places the road next to what goes before

parts.note: a port is a harbour

indicators.note: the team takes the drink inside it

parts.note: Man U is short for Manchester United, the football team
tea is a drink
W is whiskey in the NATO phonetic alphabet
O is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Football team takes drinks at a harbour bar, with whiskey after, by the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drink harbour' reads as one idea, but they are separate pieces in reverse order.
explanation.definitionFit: A blend in linguistics is a word fusing two others, like brunch, which Lewis Carroll named this.

clue.text: Acceptable game king and former queen witness

parts.note: on means acceptable, as in that's not on
loo is an old card game
K is the chess abbreviation for king
ER, Elizabeth Regina, was the late Queen Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A royal witness watches an acceptable game between a king and an old queen.
explanation.definitionFit: An onlooker is a bystander who watches events, a witness.

clue.text: Guinean regularly nicked goods off guard

indicators.note: alternate letters of Guinean are nicked away at regular intervals

parts.note: wares are goods for sale

explanation.surface: Goods are stolen from someone from Guinea at regular intervals.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of GUINEAN are U, N and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Caught unawares means taken by surprise, off guard.

clue.text: Avoid having key cut

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a keyboard
to hew is to cut

explanation.surface: Someone avoids having a key cut.
explanation.definitionFit: To eschew something is to abstain from it or shun it.

clue.text: Quickly move seats back using twice the energy

indicators.note: the reversed seats take in a further energy letter, so the word ends up with two of them
back tells us the word for seats is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: pews are church seats
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone shifts church seats around at speed, working twice as hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns PEWS into SWEP, which already holds one E; 'using twice the energy' adds a second E inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To sweep is to move swiftly and smoothly, as in sweeping past someone.

clue.text: Drink close to stations easily within reach

indicators.note: the close of a word is its final letter

parts.note: handy means near at hand, conveniently close

explanation.surface: A drink can be had close to the stations, conveniently.
explanation.definitionFit: A shandy is beer mixed with lemonade, a popular British drink.

clue.text: Commercial rep united with LNER trainee at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A sales rep and a railway trainee are lost together.
explanation.walkthrough: LNER is the London North Eastern Railway, a British train operator.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrepreneurial means relating to business enterprise, a sense of commercial.

clue.text: Favourite character eating an Italian cake

indicators.note: the favourite eats, so contains, the little word an

parts.note: a pet is a favourite
tone means character or quality

explanation.surface: A favourite person is eating an Italian cake.
explanation.definitionFit: Panettone is a sweet Milanese bread-cake eaten at Christmas.

clue.text: Troop member shot by area beyond stream

indicators.note: beyond places the area letter after the stream

parts.note: a go is a shot or attempt
a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: A soldier in a troop is shot near a stream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Troop' suggests soldiers, but a group of these great apes is also called a troop.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorillas live in family groups called troops, so one ape is a member.

clue.text: Cruising at first with speed moderate

indicators.note: at first asks for only the opening letter of cruising

parts.note: to hasten is to speed up

explanation.surface: A liner cruising sets off with speed, then a calmer pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moderate' looks like an adjective but is the verb: to tone down or restrain.
explanation.definitionFit: To chasten someone is to restrain or subdue them, a sense of moderating.

clue.text: Film doctor feeding couple

indicators.note: the doctor is fed into the couple, going inside it

parts.note: a duo is a couple or pair
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor brings food to a pair of patients.
explanation.definitionFit: Dumbo is the 1941 Disney animated feature about a flying elephant.

clue.text: Destroy pieces on America core of editors change

indicators.note: on in an across clue sets the following pieces after America

parts.note: to end something is to destroy it
chessmen are pieces, so men

indicators.note: the core of a word is its middle letter, here of editors

explanation.surface: Editors fret about a change that would wreck the American parts of a text.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle letter of the seven-letter EDITORS is T.
explanation.definitionFit: An amendment is an alteration, especially to a text or a law.

clue.text: Got in the way of deer running behind another

indicators.note: behind puts the running deer after the other deer

parts.note: another deer, here a hind, a female red deer

indicators.note: running signals the letters of deer moving about into a new order

explanation.surface: A hunted deer flees with another at its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: A hind is a female deer, so 'another' is a second deer in a different word, and 'running' scrambles the first one.
explanation.definitionFit: To be hindered is to have been obstructed or impeded; both are past tense.

clue.text: Unpleasant shower salutes maiden at foot of hill

indicators.note: in a down clue at foot of puts the maiden letter below the hill

parts.note: to hail is to salute or greet
a tor is a rocky hill
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: Greeting a young woman at the bottom of a hill in nasty weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A hailstorm is a fall of hail, an unwelcome shower of ice.

clue.text: Horizon periodically cut fare from Italy

indicators.note: every third letter of horizon is removed at a regular interval

explanation.surface: Food from Italy appears now and then on the horizon.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the first, fourth and seventh letters, H, I and N, leaves ORZO.
explanation.definitionFit: Orzo is a small rice-shaped Italian pasta, so food from Italy.

clue.text: Erected setter's tin craft before tense broadcast

indicators.note: erected in a down clue raises the pieces so they read upwards

parts.note: setter's is the setter saying I'm
Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
art is a craft or skill
T is an abbreviation for tense in grammar

explanation.surface: The setter put up a tin boat before a tense broadcast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Erected' turns IMSNART into TRANSMI.
explanation.definitionFit: To transmit is to send out a signal, as in broadcasting.

clue.text: Catch naked flames in this spot escaping from trap

indicators.note: trap is slang for mouth, so these words are what comes out of it when spoken

parts.note: old flames are lovers, and naked strips off the outer letters to leave OVER; in this spot means HERE

explanation.surface: Naked flames are spotted escaping from a trap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flames' looks literal, but old flames are former lovers; with the ends stripped, plus the word for this place, it is spoken as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch a remark accidentally is to overhear it.

clue.text: Butter westbound FedEx e-bike collects

indicators.note: in an across clue westbound means reading right to left
the phrase collects the letters within it, a run spanning the words

explanation.surface: A FedEx courier's e-bike picks up a delivery heading west.
explanation.walkthrough: XEBI runs across FedEx e-bike; 'westbound' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: An ibex is a wild mountain goat, and goats butt with their horns.

clue.text: Priest sheepish about chapter's territory

indicators.note: about means going around, so the sheep word surrounds the chapter letter

parts.note: ovine means of or like sheep

explanation.surface: A timid priest wanders round the chapter's lands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheepish' here means sheep-like, not bashful.
explanation.definitionFit: A province is a region or territory of a country.

clue.text: Niche journal covering clothes

indicators.note: clothes is a verb here: the words dress, so contain, the letters

explanation.surface: A niche magazine covers clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' looks like a noun but is a verb meaning covers.
explanation.definitionFit: An alcove is a recess or niche in a wall.

clue.text: Noted after dance what might be pieced together

indicators.note: after puts noted below dance in this down entry

parts.note: a jig is a lively dance
saw means noted or observed

explanation.surface: Something noticed after a dance that might be put together.
explanation.definitionFit: A jigsaw puzzle is assembled by fitting its pieces together.

clue.text: Unspecified number of writers once cycling most of Scottish isle

indicators.note: cycling moves a letter from one end of the word for old pens round to the other

parts.note: quills are pens of the past

indicators.note: most of drops the final letter of the island name

parts.note: Iona is an island of the Inner Hebrides

explanation.surface: Old-time writers bicycle around most of a Scottish island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycling' moves the last S of QUILLS to the front, making SQUILL; IONA loses its A.
explanation.definitionFit: A squillion is an informal huge but unspecified quantity, like a zillion.

clue.text: Bar opened with a French song

indicators.note: the bar is opened up and the French word placed inside

parts.note: a rod is a bar
un is the French for a

explanation.surface: A bar opens with a French song for the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: A round is a song for several voices entering in turn, like Frere Jacques.

clue.text: Relative supporting Afghan maybe settled opinion

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting puts the relative underneath

parts.note: an Afghan hound is a type of dog
ma is a mother, a relative

explanation.surface: A relative holds up an Afghan, perhaps with firm views.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Afghan' suggests a person, but it is the hound.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogma is a fixed set of beliefs held as unquestionable.

clue.text: Scented old beetle inside of house

parts.note: a dor is a kind of dung beetle

indicators.note: the inside of a word is its letters without the ends

explanation.surface: An old beetle smells sweet inside a house.
explanation.walkthrough: The inside of HOUSE is OUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Odorous means giving off a smell, so having a scent.

clue.text: Encounter Rolling Stone bored by fool with ecstasy

indicators.note: rolling over turns the whole assembly to read backwards
the stone is bored through and the other pieces fill the hole

parts.note: a gem is a precious stone
a nit is a fool
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A Rolling Stones band member is pestered by a fool high on drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bored by' puts NITE inside GEM to give GNITEEM; 'Rolling' turns all that round.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting is an encounter between people; both are nouns.

clue.text: Plane carrying duke, earl and one lacking in stature

indicators.note: the plane carries the duke inside it

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter aircraft

explanation.surface: A fighter jet flies a duke and an earl, one of them very short.
explanation.definitionFit: Midge is an informal term for a very small person, after the tiny fly.

clue.text: Crustacean left raw contaminated unwrapped meat

indicators.note: contaminated letters are spoilt and mixed into a new order
unwrapping removes the outside letters of meat

explanation.surface: Raw meat that has been left out of its wrapping becomes contaminated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' reads as left out, but it is fodder; 'unwrapped' strips the outer letters of the meat word before 'contaminated' mixes everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A water flea, such as daphnia, is a tiny freshwater crustacean.
